messages:
emily: Quick check — we have 3 blockers left for the marketplace listing + partner HW SKU push. Can we confirm owners?
sanjay: I can own the SI integration checklist and the docs for the connector. ETA EOD tomorrow.
claire: HW partner (NovaEdge) still needs final image assets and the SKU mapping table from their PM. Pinged them this morning.
marta: Landing page copy freeze is in my court. I’ll push final copy to /staging by 09:00 PT tomorrow.
kevin: FYI @emily I flipped the staging listing to preview mode: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.example/novaedge — images placeholders for now.
emily: thanks @kevin — reminder: press embargo is 2026-04-15T15:00:00Z. All public assets must be uploaded and approved 24h before.
sanjay: noted on embargo. For SI tests: basic deploy + smoke tests pass on our infra; need NovaEdge to validate firmware compatibility for reserved instances. I put a short runbook below:
```
- checkout release-branch
- deploy marketplace connector v1.2.3
- run smoke tests: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku NOVA-XL
- verify logs: grep -i "connector initialized" /var/log/redwood/connector.log
- report results to #partnerships with screenshot
```
claire: NovaEdge PM said asset pack will arrive by EOD today, but asked if we can accept lower-res PNGs first. We can, but final must be 2x retina by cutover.
marta: @claire okay to accept placeholders. I’ll mark images as "needs-retina" in the content tracker.
kevin: deploy-bot: run preview-check for /staging listing
deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 7842)
deploy-bot: preview-check succeeded — no broken links, styles OK :white_check_mark:
sanjay: timeline proposal:
- Today: SI runbook + NovaEdge images (placeholder)
- Tomorrow morning: content freeze + staging validation
- Tomorrow noon: final integration run with NovaEdge (30m window)
- T-24h: assets approved and uploaded
- Embargo lift: 2026-04-15T15:00:00Z
emily: That timeline works. Two asks before final green: 1) Claire — confirm asset arrival and pathname in CDN; 2) Kevin — confirm load test window for Dedicated SKU (we need a soft SLA bump for launch).
claire: Asset pack confirmed incoming at s3://novaedge-assets/marketplace/6274/ — will update when finished.
kevin: Load test window open tomorrow 11:30–12:30 PT. I’ll reserve 4 GPUs and coordinated traffic generator.
marta: Copy pushed to /staging/marketplace/novaedge/ — awaiting final images.
sanjay: will run integration at 12:00 PT tomorrow and post results here. If NovaEdge firmware fails, fallback plan: publish listing but mark as "integration pending" and disable direct deploy button.
emily: Good fallback. One more: legal asked for partner quote — @claire can you nudge NovaEdge marketing for a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in blog/press?
claire: on it. Told them the template: 1 sentence about performance + 1 about partnership. Expect reply by noon tomorrow.
kevin: small nit — make sure our analytics tag includes partner sku_id and region. I added ticket INF-8243.
emily: Perfect. If no major blockers by tomorrow 13:00 PT we call this "launch-ready" and schedule the final dry-run at 14:00 PT. :thumbsup:
marta: :party-parrot:
sanjay: Thanks team — will update after the 12:00 run.
claire: will share assets and quote as soon as I have them.
kevin: I’ll monitor the staging deploy and be ready to roll back the preview if anything flakey shows up.
deploy-bot: reminder: embargo window configured for 2026-04-15T15:00:00Z — automatic release will only occur after approval tag is added.
emily: Closing notes: document all test results in the partnership playbook (drive: Partnerships/Marketplace/NovaEdge/launch-playbook.md). Thanks everyone.
